# Influence diagram

[Previous: Strategies](./strategies.md) | [Workflow](./README.md) | [Next: Decision tree](./decision_tree.md)

Structure the decision model using decisions, uncertainties, utilities, and their relationships. Inspect model inputs before interpreting calculated results. See [Influence diagrams](../domain/influence_diagram.md) for arrow meanings, information timing, and input checks.

## Overview and navigation

### Open the influence diagram

Select **Influence Diagram** in the sidebar to view and work on the decision model.

![Influence Diagram sidebar entry](<./figures/influence_diagram/button - Influence Diagram.png>)

### Structure the influence diagram

Use the influence diagram to represent decisions, uncertainties, utilities, and their relationships. Arrows into a value node specify value dependencies; arrows into a decision specify information available before choosing; arrows into an uncertainty require the corresponding conditional probabilities. Do not add an information arrow merely to make a connection: it changes what the decision is allowed to know.

![Influence diagram page](<./figures/influence_diagram/page - Influence diagram.png>)

## Choose how to work with the diagram

### Use the diagram toolbar

The toolbar provides view modes, canvas navigation, layout controls, issue actions, and expected-value metrics.

![Influence diagram toolbar](<./figures/influence_diagram/menu - Influence diagram toolbar.png>)

### Choose a diagram view

Switch between **Card view** for issue details and **Shape view** for classic influence diagram symbols.

![Diagram view selector](<./figures/influence_diagram/field - Diagram view.png>)

### Choose a diagram interaction mode

Switch between pan and selection modes depending on whether you want to move around the canvas or select nodes.

![Influence diagram tool mode selector](<./figures/influence_diagram/field - Tool modes.png>)

## Add an issue

### Create an issue from the diagram

Select **Create Issue** in the diagram toolbar to open the issue creation form.

![Create Issue button in the influence diagram](<./figures/influence_diagram/button - Create Issue.png>)

### Describe a diagram issue

Enter the new issue's details and classification in the creation popup.

![Create Issue popup in the influence diagram](<./figures/influence_diagram/popup - Create Issue.png>)

## Inspect nodes and probability inputs

### Inspect an issue node

An issue node displays the issue within the model and provides access to its actions.

![Uncertainty issue node](<./figures/influence_diagram/card - Issue node.png>)

### Open issue-specific actions

Use a node's action menu to access editing and model inputs such as the uncertainty's probability table.

![Issue actions menu](<./figures/influence_diagram/menu - Issue actions.png>)

### Review uncertainty probabilities

Enter probabilities as fractions from 0 to 1, not percentages: use 0.4 rather than 40 for 40%. Leave each edited cell to save it, then check that every applicable parent-state row sums to 1. Complete all required rows; a cell disabled by a restriction is not a missing input to overwrite. Record the evidence behind the estimates in the issue description or decision record.

![Weather probability table](<./figures/influence_diagram/window - Probability Table.png>)

## Arrange the diagram

### Open layout controls

Select **Layout controls** to view the available options for arranging the diagram.

![Layout controls button](<./figures/influence_diagram/button - Layout controls.png>)

### Adjust the diagram layout

Use the layout popup to review and apply the available diagram arrangement settings.

![Influence diagram layout controls popup](<./figures/influence_diagram/popup - Layout controls.png>)

## Explore states and alternative views

### Expand diagram cards

Select **Expand All** to reveal the states of the diagram's decision and uncertainty cards. Expanding, collapsing, zooming, or fitting the view changes the presentation, not the model's dependencies or probability inputs.

![Expand All button in the influence diagram](<./figures/influence_diagram/button - Expand All.png>)

### Inspect expanded issue states

Expanded cards expose decision options and uncertainty outcomes directly in the diagram; use **Collapse All** to return to compact cards.

![Influence diagram with expanded cards](<./figures/influence_diagram/page - Influence diagram expanded.png>)

### Read the shape view

Shape view presents the same model with classic influence diagram symbols instead of detailed issue cards.

![Influence diagram in shape view](<./figures/influence_diagram/page - Influence diagram shape view.png>)

## Review calculated results

Read the toolbar's expected-value metrics to inspect the model's calculated results. An expected value is not a guaranteed outcome. Check whether node outcomes are selected for conditional exploration, and clear unintended selections before interpreting an unconditional baseline. After editing inputs, wait for recalculation and review warnings before relying on the displayed values.

![Expected-value metrics in the influence diagram](<./figures/influence_diagram/card - Expected value metrics.png>)
